info.title: Deftform Universal API
info.description: Build forms, collect responses, manage form fields, generate submission PDFs, and update supported form settings through the Deftform API.

post.description: Creates a form response in Deftform.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

formId.description: The Deftform form ID that should receive the new response.
